cohort: 25,251 black and white women delivering a live, singleton infant with vertex presentation at a large, regional hospital between 2004 and 2010
finding: Black women had an increased risk of cesarean delivery compared to white women, even after adjusting for sociodemographic and clinical risk factors.
mod_finding: Labor induction was a stronger risk factor for primary cesarean delivery in nulliparous black women compared to nulliparous white women.
